stories.title: Micron CEO: AI has 'totally changed' the equation for the boom-and-bust memory industry
stories.simple_summary: The company that makes computer memory chips says AI has changed how their business works, making it less predictable.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and people in the tech industry — nothing you need to do about it.

stories.title: OpenAI is gaining on Anthropic with business users, new data indicates
stories.simple_summary: Businesses keep switching between different AI tools depending on which one is better right now, making it hard to predict which company will win.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — it shows AI tool loyalty isn't guaranteed, but doesn't change how you'd use these tools.

stories.title: ChatGPT can now send texts for you with new Apple Messages plug-in
stories.simple_summary: ChatGPT can now write text messages for you through Apple Messages, so you can have it compose texts instead of typing them yourself.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use an iPhone and find texting tedious, this could save you time, though you'd still need to check that it says what you want.

stories.title: Google Discover is getting an AI chatbot-tuned feed
stories.simple_summary: Google will let you tell it what kinds of news and information you want to see, and it will use AI to automatically show you more of that in the future.
stories.why_it_matters: This could make Google's news feed more useful to you by learning your interests, similar to how a good shopkeeper learns what you like to buy.

stories.title: Brazil launches AI supercomputer push, splits projects between Chinese, US firms
stories.simple_summary: Brazil is building a very powerful computer system for AI work and splitting the projects between companies from China and the United States.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to people in Brazil's tech industry and investors — it doesn't affect your daily life.

stories.title: OK, can we actually cool data centers with our pee?
stories.simple_summary: Someone joked about using human urine to cool the computers that run AI systems, and it turns out this is actually not a completely ridiculous idea.
stories.why_it_matters: This is research into solving a real problem (data centers use a lot of water for cooling), but it's very early and doesn't affect you yet.

stories.title: Google gives publishers a new way to fight AI-driven traffic losses
stories.simple_summary: Google is giving newspaper and website owners a button they can offer readers to say 'use me as your main source,' so they get more traffic.
stories.why_it_matters: If you run a small website or newsletter, this could help you keep readers, since AI search is sending fewer people to individual websites.

stories.title: Runlayer, Rippling drop lawsuits — but the brouhaha is still a cautionary tale for founders
stories.simple_summary: Two tech companies, Runlayer and Rippling, dropped their lawsuits against each other with no money changing hands, but one launched a competing product anyway.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and business lawyers — it's a cautionary tale about disagreements between companies, not something you need to act on.

stories.title: Linkdaze’s smart calendar is built to run a household, not just track a schedule
stories.simple_summary: A new digital calendar app called Linkdaze helps you manage household tasks and meal planning with AI help, and doesn't charge extra for the main features.
stories.why_it_matters: If you're looking for an organized way to plan meals and household tasks, this could be worth trying, especially since the good features don't cost extra.

stories.title: Grok keeps sending gibberish responses to users
stories.simple_summary: Grok, an AI chatbot, has been giving users nonsensical answers and weird responses.
stories.why_it_matters: This only matters if you use Grok — if you do, it might be best to wait until they fix the problem.

stories.title: A third of web pages published since ChatGPT’s launch show signs of AI authorship, study finds
stories.simple_summary: A study found that about one-third of new web pages created since ChatGPT launched appear to have been written or edited by AI.
stories.why_it_matters: This means a lot of what you read online is now written by AI, so be a little more careful about trusting everything you see without checking sources.

stories.title: Ramp launches its own AI model router, called Router
stories.simple_summary: A company called Ramp built a tool that lets you pick and switch between different AI models easily through a technical connection.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to software engineers and companies building AI tools — average users don't need to know about this.
